rules.statement: A donation by a lessee without the written consent of the Crown is voidable at the instance of the Crown and not absolutely void. The executor and residuary legatee under the last will of the lessee is bound by the donation and cannot vindicate the property from the donees.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that a donation by the lessee without the written consent of the Crown was voidable at the instance of the Crown and not absolutely void. Held further, that the executor and residuary legatee under the last will of the lessee is bound by the donation and cannot vindicate the property from the donees."
